purpose: Read one bounded, complete, ordered page of one record type's full-history Initial Snapshot or Reconciliation Snapshot from Health Connect, projected through project-source-record, with a tentative project-owned next position and exhaustion state; or a page-level projection refusal, a missing permission, a read failure, or an invalid position, none of which advances the position. The reader claims no durable progress.

inputs.name: record_type
inputs.description: One record type name from project-source-record's PROJECTION_SCHEMA_VERSIONS, such as steps.

inputs.name: snapshot_identity
inputs.description: The lowercase UUID of the Initial or Reconciliation Snapshot attempt, issued by begin-initial-snapshot or begin-reconciliation-snapshot and used as the Wire Protocol cycle_id.

inputs.name: snapshot_page_position
inputs.description: None for the snapshot's first page, or the exact position bytes a previous page of the same record type and snapshot returned.

inputs.name: projection_context
inputs.description: The project-source-record ProjectionContext for the Polling Run: the projection-implementation version and the Health Connect provider version, supplied by the caller.

inputs.name: permission_state
inputs.description: The Health Connect permissions granted to the Sender, read through the access seam immediately before and immediately after the page read.

inputs.name: health_connect_records
inputs.description: The records of the type that Health Connect returns for the page read, from every data origin.

outputs.name: snapshot_page
outputs.description: The record type, snapshot identity, and projection-schema version; the exact Source Projection bytes of every record on the page in Health Connect's order; the tentative next position as canonical bytes; and whether the snapshot is exhausted.

outputs.name: page_projection_refusal
outputs.description: The first project-source-record refusal on the page, carrying only its failure name, record type, and JSON path, so the caller can block the type with reason projection-refusal at the unchanged position.

outputs.name: not_permitted
outputs.description: Which required permission was missing, read or history, with no page and no position change.

outputs.name: read_failure
outputs.description: One named read failure with no exception text, page, or position change, which the caller reports as failed with reason read-failed and retries on a later run.

outputs.name: invalid_position
outputs.description: A named reason the supplied position cannot be used, so the caller abandons the attempt and begins a new snapshot.

observable_effects.name: health-connect-read
observable_effects.description: Reads granted permissions twice and records of one type once from Health Connect; never writes, updates, or deletes Health Connect data, and never requests a permission or route consent.

owns: the Health Connect read request for a snapshot page: record type, time range, every data origin, ascending order, and record limit
the project-owned snapshot page position, its canonical bytes, and the guarantee that a record present and unchanged throughout a traversal appears on exactly one page
page completeness: every record on a page is projected, or the whole page is refused
the full-history and read permission requirements for a snapshot page read
classification of Health Connect read errors into the named failures
does_not_own: snapshot identity, changes-token issuance, snapshot kind, and snapshot completion, which belong to begin-initial-snapshot, begin-reconciliation-snapshot, and stage-sync-completion
persisting positions, staging Outbox Messages, encryption, and fragmentation, which belong to stage-outbox-batch
scheduling, retry, Projection Refusal identity and blocking, permission-gap pauses, and invalid-position escalation, which belong to coordinate-sender-sync
change pages, changes tokens, and Source Retractions, which belong to read-change-page
the projection of each record, which belongs to project-source-record
requesting permissions, background-read eligibility, and feature availability
exposing the reader to the TypeScript shell through the Expo module
